display_long_description:
Step into the most hyper-realistic bakery ever built in virtual reality. In Cake or Fake, your mission is simple but mind-bending: create cakes that look so fake, then put them to the ultimate challenge.
[media]
Master the Art of Deception
Forget standard round cakes. Use our advanced sculpting tools to mold, frost, and paint cakes that look like sneakers, succulent plants, power tools, 
[media]

and more. If it exists in the real world, you can bake it—and fake it.
[media]

Features That Blur Reality
Ultra-Realistic Physics: Experience a cutting-edge physics engine where batter pours, fondant drapes, and knives slice with satisfying, true-to-life resistance.

Stunning Visual Effects (VFX): High-fidelity textures and lighting make your glazes shimmer and your crumbs look good enough to eat.

Immersive Spatial Audio: From the tactile crunch of a hard chocolate shell to the soft poof of powdered sugar, every sound is engineered for total immersion.

The "Final Cut" Moment: Take your creation to the judging table. Watch in high-tension slow motion as the knife descends. Will the judges be fooled, or will your cover be blown?
